name: Lavrith Tranzatto
original_name: レイリス＝トランザット
source: A paladin of the church and the sole holder of the title of "saint", Lavrith has sworn an oath to fight against demons and monsters as well as any enemies of the church and kingdom.
translation: A paladin of the church and the sole holder of the title of "saint", Lavrith has sworn an oath to fight against demons and monsters as well as any enemies of the church and kingdom.
